notes: Results site: search results show the elections site moved to elections.bexar.gov (title 'Bexar County Elections, TX'), with historical reports at elections.bexar.gov/35/Historical and bexar.org/2186/Historical-Election-Results, and a legacy page home.bexar.org/el45a.html titled 'Election Results'. Historical reports are county-hosted PDFs (for example bexar.org/DocumentCenter/View/44008/November-5-2024-Official-Summary-Report). Platform left unknown: two search tool summaries said 'Real-time results are available via Clarity Elections', but no result title or URL showed a clarityelections.com address, so that is a lead only and does not fix the election-night platform. Phone and email: the search summary listed '210-335-VOTE (8683)' and an obfuscated email for the Elections Department, but these did not appear in a result title, URL, or attributable quoted text, so they are leads only and left empty. Fetch module attempts to elections.bexar.gov and elections.bexar.org/1840/Contact-Us failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). Wayback probe for home.bexar.org/el45a.html failed for all windows. WebFetch to sanantonioreport.org was EGRESS_BLOCKED. Timing: search summaries referenced 'November 5, 2024 Official Election Precinct Results' and a 'November 4, 2025 Official Precinct Report', which are official (post-canvass) reports and do not show whether unofficial precinct results were posted on election night. Stated change: a San Antonio Report article (sanantonioreport.org/bexar-county-election-modernization-2026-midterm-election/) was summarized as saying the county 'overhauled its website to deliver results', and a summary said the elections website got 'a new look and a .gov domain'; neither is shown to mention precinct-level reporting, so stated_change_2026 is n. Usage notice: none seen verbatim.
tag_rationale: No citable source states when precinct-level results first appeared on election night; only official post-canvass precinct reports are evidenced.
